description: This file defines the 'OrderViewModel' class, which manages the UI-related data for order operations in a Kotlin-based Android application. It handles order filtering, order list paging, order creation, order retrieval, and order state transitions, utilizing Kotlin coroutines, Flow, LiveData, and Android architecture components.

classes.name: OrderViewModel
classes.description: A ViewModel class managing order data, filters, and state transitions for an Android app.

methods.name: setStatusFilter
methods.description: Updates the order status filter used for paging.

methods.name: setEmailFilter
methods.description: Sets the email query filter, debounced to reduce rapid updates.

methods.name: setDateFrom
methods.description: Sets the starting date filter for order search.

methods.name: setDateTo
methods.description: Sets the ending date filter for order search.

methods.name: clearFilters
methods.description: Resets all filter states to their default values.

methods.name: createOrderFromSample
methods.description: Creates a new order using a sample payload, handling success or errors.

methods.name: getOrder
methods.description: Fetches a single order by ID.

methods.name: transition
methods.description: Helper to execute order state transitions and handle errors.
